t: These are the Queen Elizabeth Gates, also called the Queen Mother's Gate, at the edge of Hyde Park behind Apsley House at Hyde Park Corner. They're a set of two pairs and two single gates in forged stainless steel and bronze, with a painted cast iron feature at the centre. They're named for Queen Elizabeth the Queen Mother, who was queen consort from 1936 to 1952 as the wife of King George the Sixth. She took the title Queen Mother after his death, to avoid confusion with her daughter, Elizabeth the Second.
